nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint256) storing token balances of holders.
Public string token name set to BAZAN__20230515.
Public string token symbol set to BAZANI.
Public uint8 token decimals set to 18.
Public uint256 total token supply, initialized to 15649075219292400000000000.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of approved spending amounts.
Constructor-like public function that mints totalSupply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
Public transfer function moving value from msg.sender to a recipient.
Public approve function setting allowance[msg.sender][spender] to value.
Public transferFrom function moving value using an existing allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, spender and mapping key throughout the contract.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Amount parameter of approve.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value in transfer, unchecked subtraction of a user-supplied amount.
balanceOf[to] += value in transfer, unchecked addition to an arbitrary recipient.
allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value in approve, unrestricted state write by the caller.
balanceOf[from] -= value in transferFrom, unchecked subtraction from an arbitrary source.
balanceOf[to] += value in transferFrom, unchecked addition to an arbitrary recipient.
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value in transferFrom, unchecked allowance decrement.
balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply in the constructor-like function, minting the whole supply to the deployer.

edges.reason: Constructor uses msg.sender as the recipient of the initial supply.
totalSupply is assigned into balanceOf[msg.sender] during initialization.
msg.sender is the mapping key for the initial balance assignment.
approve function executes the allowance state write.
msg.sender indexes the allowance owner slot in approve.
spender parameter indexes the allowance spender slot.
value parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
transfer performs the unchecked subtraction from the sender balance.
msg.sender is the mapping key whose balance is decremented.
value parameter is the amount subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
transfer performs the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
to parameter is the mapping key whose balance is incremented.
value parameter is the amount added to balanceOf[to].
transferFrom performs the unchecked subtraction from the source balance.
from parameter is the mapping key whose balance is decremented.
value parameter is the amount subtracted from balanceOf[from].
transferFrom performs the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
to parameter is the mapping key whose balance is incremented.
value parameter is the amount added to balanceOf[to].
transferFrom performs the unchecked allowance decrement.
from parameter indexes the allowance owner slot.
msg.sender indexes the allowance spender slot that is decremented.
value parameter is the amount subtracted from the allowance.
msg.sender is used as the spender key when checking allowance in transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter to of transfer only feeds the recipient balance addition, so it is folded into that core unsafe operation.
Amount parameter value of transfer is the operand of the sender balance subtraction and is normalized into that core unsafe operation.
Spender parameter of approve is only used as the allowance spender key, so it merges into the allowance write unsafe operation.
Amount parameter value of approve is stored directly in the allowance mapping, so it merges into that core state write.
Source parameter from of transferFrom is the mapping key of the balance subtraction and normalizes into it.
Recipient parameter to of transferFrom feeds only the balance addition and merges into that unsafe operation.
Amount parameter value of transferFrom is the operand of the allowance decrement and normalizes into that core unsafe operation.
